messages:
Asha (partnerships): Heads up — NexiCloud just updated the shipment manifest. They moved ~30% of our reserved blades from the week of May 3 -> May 17 due to a customs slot push. This affects the Dedicated commitments for three customers.
Miguel (supply): Ugh. Which SKUs and which customers?
Asha (partnerships): SKUs: NC-4xA100 and NC-8xH100. Affected commits: ACME (starts 5/6), Greenfold (pilot 5/9), Stately (scale 5/12). I attached their manifest excerpt to the vendor email I forwarded earlier.
Priya (acct mgmt): For ACME that start date is locked in their contract (onboarding plan + SSO cutover). If hardware not there we need plan B or credit language. Can we float them hosted capacity for 2 weeks?
Jun (infra): We can allocate hosted burst for ACME but two caveats: 1) cost delta (hosted > dedicated), 2) it may require a small network change for their VPC peering.
Miguel (supply): I'm checking PO numbers vs. carrier ETA. NexiCloud says reason is a rebooked vessel and a customs inspection in the FRA hub. They only gave a range: 5/16–5/19 for the delayed batch.
Asha (partnerships): I'll ask them for a manifest-level split. Can we propose a partial split: ship the NC-8xH100 units first (ACME needs H100s), delay the A100s which go to Stately?
Miguel (supply): I'll ask carrier. If carrier will prioritize H100 crates we can get ACME green. If not, we need infra fallback.
Priya (acct mgmt): I'll ping ACME with a heads-up. No commitments yet — just transparency. If we have to use hosted burst, can we promise an equivalently-configured runtime? They care about latency.
Jun (infra): We can mirror the Dedicated runtime on hosted, same model versions and quantization. Latency will be slightly higher but within their SLA except for 99th percentile. We can add an opt-in canary route to limit impact.
LogisticsBot: [automated] Carrier update received: FRA inspection window extended. Next status update expected in 18 hours.
Asha (partnerships): Ok plan of action: 1) Miguel — confirm whether carrier can split shipments by SKU and provide firm ETAs for the H100 crates (timeline: 3h). 2) Jun — draft hosted-burst config template and estimated cost delta for a 2-week temporary migration (timeline: 6h). 3) Priya — prepare ACME comms draft (sensitive) and options matrix (credit vs. hosted) (timeline: 4h). I'll compile everything and escalate to NexiCloud CSM if no clear split.
Miguel (supply): On it. I already have the carrier contact on the thread — escalating now.
Priya (acct mgmt): Drafting comms. Will include timeline, technical workaround, and a note about credits if we miss the contract milestone.
Jun (infra): I'll include a togglable routing policy we can enable to route ACME traffic to hosted nodes and fallback automatically when dedicated becomes available.
Asha (partnerships): Thanks. If we get firm splits, we might be able to preserve the commitments with minimal customer impact. If not, we should coordinate legal on amendment language. Will update in ~4 hours. :pray:
Miguel (supply): Carrier replied — they can prioritize H100 crates but need confirmation by EOD to reroute. Sending quote for rush handling now.
Priya (acct mgmt): Got the quote. I'll wait for Jun's cost delta then propose the least-customer-disruptive option.
Asha (partnerships): Cool. Filing this as a high-priority partner capacity ticket. I'll post updates here.
